seo.title: About | Scruffyhipster
seo.description: Scruffyhipster is an independent Apple software studio building quiet tools for focus, recovery, habits, and everyday systems.

intro.heading: Less noise. More agency.
paragraphs: Scruffyhipster is an independent software studio building native apps for people who want their devices to behave a little better. The work is practical, opinionated, and deliberately small.
The goal is not to make you more productive every second. It is to make useful moments easier to protect.
features: Native Apple apps built with Swift, SwiftUI, and system APIs where they matter.
Behaviour-first design: prompts, pauses, timers, routines, and small decisions.
No noisy growth loops, fake urgency, or attention tricks.

principles.heading: Native where it matters
principles.body: The apps are built for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac using Apple platform conventions instead of web-shaped compromises.

principles.heading: Friction on purpose
principles.body: Some tools should slow you down for half a second. A good pause can be more useful than another notification.

contact.heading: Send a note.
contact.body: For app support, product questions, or small software conversations. Short messages are welcome.
